name: Leire Pajín, Aurelijus Veryga - Article 31, après le § 1 - Am 334
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Union Civil Protection Mechanism and Union support for health emergency preparedness and response, and repealing Decision No 1313/2013/EU (Union Civil Protection Mechanism)
part_text: 1a. The use of military assets and capacities for providing assistance through the Union mechanism shall remain a last resort, under civilian oversight, subject to formal proof of the unavailability of civilian means. The deployment of these military assets shall be strictly limited to non-combat transport and logistical support under civilian operational direction, and no funds under this Regulation shall be allocated for the procurement or maintenance of military-grade equipment
